resolution.note: One owner per worker baseline bound: hardening 10000/1 GB duplicate removed; input-bounds owns file count (.krn, 10000 fit + 10001 refused) and accumulated bytes (1 B + 1 GB across roots); model/effort value table moved to schema unit test with one CLI case per flag. Mutations of visited limit (>=, +1), per-file bytes and byte limit +1 each fail a test. Shard target stale: after #262 (8 shards) the slowest test step is 33 s (run 42417612653), so 20 s off is not reachable from these files; local wall input-bounds 34.7->32.7 s, hardening 27.3->23.9 s.

title: CI: consolidate redundant worker hardening and input-bounds tests
body: Roadmap R4. CI baseline (.krn/runs/lead/weakness-hunt/ci-baseline.md): worker/hardening 137 s and worker/input-bounds 129 s of 1464 s total; tests-audit.md: the ~10000-file bound is tested in four places. Outcome: one owner test per bound, slowest shard at least 20 s faster, no behaviour lost (mutation of each bound still fails a test).
